sections.heading: Company profile
sections.body:
NUtec Digital Ink is a globally recognized manufacturer of premium digital ink solutions for UV-curable, water-based, and eco-solvent inkjet printing with a strong presence in over 100 countries.

Industry: Chemicals & Materials · Size: <$50M · Products: UV-curable inks, Solvent inks, Water-based inks, Cleaning solutions, Coatings and varnishes, Bulk ink delivery systems

sections.heading: Qualification summary
sections.body: NUtec Digital Ink scores 62 of 100 (tier B) at 90% confidence. The score is carried by application fit (24/25), event engagement (11/15) and pain-point alignment (15/15).

sections.heading: Tedlar angle
sections.body: They already market on uv resistance, chemical resistance, lifespan, which means the durability conversation is a product discussion rather than an education. Relevant Tedlar positioning: Tedlar PVF films hold colour and gloss through years of direct UV exposure. Tedlar resists solvents, cleaners and road chemicals without hazing. Tedlar overlaminates let printers underwrite longer graphic warranties.

sections.heading: Comparable accounts
sections.body: Closest known-good accounts: Mactac (26% similar on digital, printing, signage, specialty); ORAFOL Europe (13% similar on digital, printing, films, graphics); Drytac (12% similar on print, printing, media, digital). Reference the comparable account by name on the call — a converter is far more persuaded by what a peer does than by a spec sheet.
